start: Owner signed in. Menu 'Workout plans', the gym has plans

user_sees: Title 'Workout plans', 'Send members their routines', button '+ New plan'
'Members see it in the MettleUp app after one check-in at the gym.'
Card 'Plans': each plan's name, who it goes to, and '<days and exercises> · Updated <day> · by <name>'
Buttons 'Edit', 'Make a copy', 'Withdraw' on each
must_not: Withdrawn plans mixed into the list
A staff login sent away from this screen

user_sees: Sheet 'Edit workout plan' filled with the plan
must_not: A blank builder
Another plan opened

user_sees: Toast '“<name>” updated.' (or '“<name>” saved. Tick members to send it.' when nobody is ticked)
The row shows today's date after 'Updated'
must_not: A second plan with the same name
'by <name>' changed to the person who edited

start: Owner signed in, on the plans list

steps.action: Tap 'Make a copy' on a plan
user_sees: Sheet 'New workout plan' filled with the plan's days and exercises (the copy's name and who it goes to: unknown)
must_not: The original plan changed
The copy sent to the same members without the user seeing it under 'Send to'

user_sees: A new row in 'Plans'
Toast '“<name>” saved and sent.' or '“<name>” saved. Tick members to send it.'
must_not: The original gone

start: Owner signed in, on 'Workout plans' with nothing or with trouble

steps.action: Open the screen in a gym with no plans
user_sees: 'No workout plans yet' and 'Make a plan once (for example “Beginner 3 days”) and send it to members or to everyone on a membership plan.'
Button '+ New plan'
must_not: A blank card
An error

steps.action: Open it in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Members get these plans only once your gym is online (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: 'Members see it in the MettleUp app…' when no phone can ever get the plan

user_sees: A red banner with the reason, or 'Could not withdraw it. Try again.'
The plan still in 'Plans'
must_not: Toast 'Plan withdrawn.' for a plan that was not withdrawn

start: Owner signed in, a plan that goes to members

user_sees: Sheet 'Withdraw this plan?' with '<name> will stop going to members. Routines already on their phones stay there, but get no more changes. You can’t send this plan again; make a copy of it instead.'
Buttons 'Keep it' and 'Withdraw'
must_not: The plan withdrawn before the question is answered

user_sees: The plan still in 'Plans'
must_not: Any change

user_sees: Toast 'Plan withdrawn.'
The plan leaves 'Plans'
A folded card 'Withdrawn plans (1)'
must_not: The plan deleted
The routine removed from a member's phone

user_sees: 'Members no longer get these. Routines already on their phones stay there.'
The plan with only 'Make a copy'
must_not: 'Edit' or a way to send it again
A way to bring it back (there is none: make a copy)

start: Owner signed in, reading the plans list

user_sees: Who it goes to as a short summary and 'by <name>' of the staff member who made it
must_not: Plans of another gym
Member phone numbers on the list
A member seeing a plan that was not sent to them
